name: PIXMA TS5050
description: Inkjet printer, measured on a PIXMA TS5050. Other units in the series report the same "TS5000 series" model over IPP.
measure_description: Measured on a PIXMA TS5050 (GTIN 4549292066517). IPP only reports "TS5000 series", so the profile lives under the measured model id and keeps "TS5000 series" as its discovery alias — other printers in the series therefore use this profile too. Created from a Powercalc Measure recording (measure app 0.14.3, Shelly Plug S Gen3, 230 V): one run over 64 minutes with 1857 samples, 1712 idle and 56 printing. Idle shows two reachable levels (about 1.1 W in deep sleep, about 3.7 W awake on WiFi), so the energy-weighted average is used. Printing averages 10.8 W (median 11.6 W, peak 19.2 W).
